subject: BCP evidence: ownership inventory + RTO/RPO proofs
messages:
From: Emma Larson <emma.larson@clearpay.com>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@clearpay.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: BCP ownership inventory + RTO/RPO proof for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Dev,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We are moving forward with the SIG assessment and need some focused BCP/DR artifacts to close a couple of control gaps on our side. Can you please provide the following by EOD Wed (11/11)?

- Ownership inventory: list of on-call owners, service/component mapping (who owns what), escalation contacts. A CSV is fine.
- RTO and RPO evidence: last snapshot times, warm cache restore test logs, and a short explanation of the recovery steps for hosted endpoints.
- Any CAIQ/SIG mapping notes you have that point to your BCP controls (we only need pointers, not full docs).

We’ve got a compliance call on Thursday; the auditor will expect demonstrable artifacts. If you can’t share certain pieces publicly, flag them and we’ll accept redacted samples or a secure link.

Best,
Emma Larson
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
ClearPay Compliance

--

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: BCP ownership inventory + RTO/RPO proof for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the note. We can absolutely provide those artifacts. I attached an initial ownership inventory CSV and a ZIP with RTO/RPO snapshots from our last warm-start test (11/08). Quick summary below and proposed next steps:

Summary:
- Ownership inventory (redwood-bcp-ownership-inventory.csv): service, primary owner, secondary owner, escalation phone, on-call rotation window.
- RTO/RPO snapshots (rto-rpo-snapshots-20261108.zip): timestamps for last two snapshot runs, restore timestamps from the warm-start, and the test-run checklist.
- Redactions: cryptographic key access logs are redacted; we can provide an attest letter from our security team under NDA if needed.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll upload unredacted artifacts to a shared folder under a restricted link (see Drive link).
2) Schedule a 30-minute call with our on-call engineer and Markus to walk through the restore sequence (I suggest Wed 11/11 14:00 CET).
3) If the auditor needs a live witness of the restore, we can arrange a supervised session during their window.

Let me know if Wed 14:00 CET works and whether you want the unredacted pack under an NDA or via your portal.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-bcp-ownership-inventory.csv (CSV stub), rto-rpo-snapshots-20261108.zip (ZIP stub)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: BCP ownership inventory + RTO/RPO proof for SIG/CAIQ

Dev —

A couple of operational notes to include with the artifacts (copying Marissa for any additional intake items):

- Snapshot cadence: our primary region has a 15-minute MVCC snapshot cadence for KV and hourly for full model checkpoints; the CSV indicates which services rely on which snapshot type.
- Warm-start restore: the attached test log in the ZIP contains the automated steps we run (k8s job ids, cache warm-up sequence, and the final health-check hook). The run on 11/08 completed in 27m (RTO measured at the route-level from request arrival to model-ready state).
- RPO explanation: shortest RPO is ~15 minutes for KV cache; for cold-started artifacts we document manual bootstrap time and fallback routing policies in the runbook.
- Key-holder contacts: the inventory references primary key-holders by role (e.g., Crypto Ops Lead) rather than personal emails for audit privacy; we can provide on-call numbers under NDA.

If you want, I’ll draft a one-page control narrative that maps these artifacts to SIG/CAIQ control IDs (SOC2 control crosswalk is also straightforward).

-Markus
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
